chapterTitle: A Bottle of Dew (Folk Tale by Sudha Murty)
overview: Rama Natha spends years trying to find a magic potion to turn objects into gold. A wise sage tricks him into planting banana trees and collecting morning dew. In doing so, Rama Natha earns a real fortune by selling the harvested bananas.
centralTheme: Real wealth comes from hard work, not magic shortcuts., Experiential wisdom is more effective than lectures.
moralLessons: Real wealth comes from hard work, not magic shortcuts.
Experiential wisdom is more effective than lectures.
